moments.action: Low-angle wide of the garage lane: two women in western outfits walk away between the two staged cars, clearing it. Cuts to each driver alone at the wheel, the Asian racer then the young American.
A man in a dark suit walks out into the lane and turns, arm swinging; whip-pans sweep the packed spectators and a woman in a red cowboy hat. He ends planted between the cars, head down.
The crowd surges past a woman at a pillar; headlights push forward with spectators jammed along both walls and a phone held up to film. By the last shot a car is already rolling into the lane.

The two cars settle side by side at the line. The harnessed Asian driver looks over, the American grins back, then a hand flips a switch on the gauge panel and he takes a two-handed grip on the wheel.

A car noses past the cones while the crowd watches, a kid in a red beanie and a woman in black among them. Inside the cars the two drivers trade a last look; the Asian one smirks and turns into the wheel.
Tyres smoke and the cars break away, the orange-and-blue coupe sliding past the level 6 sign. Out of the smoke they run off down an emptier deck past parked cars.
Spectators whoop and shout as the cars pass. The cutting settles away from them onto a long-haired man in a pale jacket beside a black car, snacking as he tracks the race and talks off-frame.

The orange-and-blue car blasts past clapping spectators and both cars thread a wider deck; two phones relay the race on their screens. Inside, both drivers saw at the wheel, ending on a blurred spinning tyre.
A lift opens onto the garage deck with spectators crammed inside; the next shot is in among them, a man in a leather jacket at the front staring out over the others.

A dark coupe drifts onto a near-empty lower deck ahead of the orange car and blurs past. Spectators lined along the wall break and run clear as the cars come through; the American driver watches ahead.

The American wrestles the wheel, shouting, then grimaces down before glaring out through the windscreen past the C-WEST banner. The orange car grinds its flank along the concrete wall, throwing sparks.
